findings.evidence: roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/RealAlgebraicGeometry/README.md:310-313 prescribes exactly 'Prove the Kronecker-product identity and invertibility, and recover all counts' and line 338 gives 'References: BPR Chapter 10; Cohen–Mahboubi; Cordwell–Tan–Platzer'; README.md:659-662 describes Cohen–Mahboubi as 'Precedent for ... sign determination'. grep for Basu|Cohen|Mahboubi in code/TauCeti/Geometry/RealAlgebraic returns no hits; the only reference hit in the PR is Polynomial.lean:25 (Ben-Or, Kozen, Reif).
findings.fix: Add to the References block: S. Basu, R. Pollack, M.-F. Roy, Algorithms in Real Algebraic Geometry, 2nd ed., Ch. 10 (sign determination, tensor power of the 3×3 matrix), and C. Cohen, A. Mahboubi, Formal proofs in real algebraic geometry: from ordered fields to quantifier elimination, LMCS 8(1) 2012 (taq, constraint counts, ctmat and its invertibility). Also add a one-line pointer to the same references in the Moments.lean module docstring, since fullMatrix/fullInverse is the central construction and that file carries no reference.
findings.issue: The References block cites only Ben-Or–Kozen–Reif, but the PR does not follow BKR's recursive method. Its plan (signSum/signCount over an arbitrary finite set Z, full 3^m tensor matrix with explicit rational inverse, then specialization to roots) is the naive sign determination of Basu–Pollack–Roy Ch. 10 and mirrors Cohen–Mahboubi's taq/constraints/ctmat development, which likewise sums signs over an arbitrary point sequence before specializing to roots.

summary: The BKR paper is credited, but the construction actually followed is the full ternary Kronecker-matrix inversion over an arbitrary finite point set, which is BPR Chapter 10 and the Cohen–Mahboubi formalization (taq over a point sequence, constraint counts, tensor matrix ctmat and its invertibility), both listed by the roadmap as the precedents for this milestone. Neither is named in the code or the PR description.
